import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize relationships between all numerical features, colored by species
# This is highly insightful for the Iris dataset as it shows how species separate based on measurements.
g = sns.pairplot(df, hue="species", diag_kind="kde", palette="viridis")

# Add a title to the entire figure
g.fig.suptitle("Pairwise Relationships of Iris Flower Measurements by Species", y=1.02, fontsize=16)

# Improve legend placement if necessary, though pairplot usually handles it well.
# For pairplot, the legend is typically part of the figure.
# You can further customize legend if needed, for example:
# g._legend.set_title("Species")

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
